apac_consistency.disclaimer: Per-group values are label-free consistency proxies (flip consistency and crop stability), NOT accuracy against ground-truth landmarks, because the APAC images carry no landmark annotations. Group labels come from the dataset's file names (annotator-provided demographic metadata), not from inference on facial appearance. Lower is better.
